snippet.title: Bibi Beep World – Official Trailer | Pretend Play Game for Kids (No Ads)
snippet.description:
Bibi Beep World is a colourful pretend-play world for kids: 51 places in 10 regions, each with its own little story and secrets. Style hair at the salon, take a bubble bath, cook dinner, watch the circus, fill a hot spring for capybaras and fly hot air balloons at night. No rules, no timers: kids make their own stories.

Bibi Beep World, çocukların kendi hikâyesini kurduğu rengârenk bir hayal oyunu dünyası: 10 bölgede 51 yer, her birinin kendi küçük hikâyesi ve sırları var.

✓ No ads  ✓ No chat  ✓ Plays offline  ✓ Ages 4-12  ✓ 20 languages
Reklamsız • Sohbet yok • İnternetsiz • 4-12 yaş

▶ Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bibibeep.app&referrer=utm_source%3Dyoutube%26utm_medium%3Dvideo%26utm_campaign%3DAq5NGa-_BNU
🌐 https://bibibeep.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=Aq5NGa-_BNU
